title: ‘Constitution supreme’: SC issues contempt notice to Kerala Congress over post against CJI Surya Kant

ai.summary: The Supreme Court issued a contempt notice to Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) office bearers for a post targeting CJI Surya Kant over remarks during October protests related to Delhi Police excesses in Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court issued a contempt notice to office bearers of the Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) regarding a post targeting Chief Justice of India Surya Kant
facts.quote: The Supreme Court of India on Friday issued a contempt notice to office bearers of the Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) regarding a post targeting Chief Justice of India Surya Kant last month.

facts.claim: The matter was heard by a bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M Pancholi
facts.quote: The matter was heard by a bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M Pancholi.

facts.claim: The court stated that the Constitution is supreme and no political organisation or institution is above it
facts.quote: The Constitution is supreme. No individual, no institution or political organisation stands above it. The independence of the judiciary is not a matter of political convenience. It is a constitutional guarantee owed to the Republic, to the people of this Republic,

facts.claim: The court noted that any attempt to undermine the authority of the court is required to be dealt with an iron hand
facts.quote: The top court also noted that any attempt to "undermine the authority of the court is required to be dealt with an iron hand."

facts.claim: The court appointed a senior advocate as amicus curiae to examine criminal or civil contempt
facts.quote: The top court added it has appointed a senior advocate as amicus curiae in the matter to examine whether criminal or civil contempt would apply in the matter

facts.claim: The post was made by KPCC targeting CJI Surya Kant over remarks during October protests related to Delhi Police excesses in Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests
facts.quote: The Supreme Court's order comes after a post by the KPCC targeting CJI Surya Kant over a remark made during a hearing by the top court on a bunch of petitions seeking a probe into excesses by the Delhi Police during the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests in the capital city.

ai.background_note: The Supreme Court issued a contempt notice to KPCC office bearers for a post targeting CJI Surya Kant over remarks during October protests related to Delhi Police excesses in Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests.
